name: Notes
description: Pin personal or public notes to model preview images, as bubbles or sticky notes, and find all the notes you wrote on your sticky board.
author: Thingport contributors

screenshots.caption: A model's picture with notes on it: taped sticky notes and bubble pins, yours and a housemate's, and the count on the sticky note in the corner.
Writing a new note on the picture itself: drag it by its grip, and pick bubble or sticky, its colour and who sees it in the toolbar under it.
In the dark theme, a housemate's public note opened in place, with who wrote it, when and who can see it.
The menu on the corner's sticky note adds a note, opens the Notes window, or hides every note on pictures while you look at the model.
The Notes window: every note you wrote, in its own colour, with the model it's on, to filter by model title or note text.
In the dark theme, a note's menu in the window opens its model or deletes the note.
